program.section_heading: Learning Strategies: Academic Skills, Certificate of Competency
outcomes: Analyze personal learning difficulties and identify learning strategies to incorporate into college level courses.
Select appropriate adaptive software and technology to support learning in college level courses
Identify and understand ADA accommodations that are mandated by law and how they apply to the college setting.

notes: This is a noncredit CDCP Certificate of Competency, but the catalog states its requirements only as 0.0 units and prints no hours for the courses or the award. Measure is therefore recorded as units, with the printed 0 values.

The catalog prints an outer requirement 'Learning Strategies: Academic Skills (Total 0) Complete all of the following'. It wraps the single block 'REQUIRED COURSES - ALL NON-CREDIT', so only the inner block is recorded.
IIS901 (Improving Learning Potential) is required by the catalog but is absent from the closed list. It is recorded as a catalog addition.
Course codes are recorded as printed, without a space: IIS901, IIS902, IIS903. IIS902 and IIS903 match closed-list IIS 902 and IIS 903.
The line 'Upon satisfactory completion of this award, the student should be prepared to:' appears twice. The outcomes are printed only under the Program Learning Outcomes heading.
